servers.name: let me put you on about a github user named 347. so they wanted to fork an annisette server because sidestore's is god fucking awful and its server.json was down. so they host their own server.json to point at, but that didn't work. they blamed everything else that could be related before circling back to this, then hosting it on github pages... on the wrong site. so, they put it on a conveinently placed repo they made (which really isn't related) to point at their forked annisette server. this is where they are and they're praying that it works. however, it was SO close to. they logged in, but... no valid server found. odd, they LITERALLY JUST GAVE IT ONE!!!!! looking at the logs, they figured out that somehow, somewhere, it was using v1 instead of v3. what the fuck? anyways, with a little bit of (definetly not vibecoded) debugging, they realised that they got the fucking filename wrong like a dumbass. they try that and pray AGAIN that it works cause they starting to lose thier shit. now however, they blame the name for being this long, and set it to something short to, i don't know, "My Anisette" or some shit and forgets what the journey was. they join the discord server for shits and giggles and eventually they fix the issue itself. it wasn't anisette (suprisingly), it was the fucking VPN config. all along it was this iface bullshit that they had to get a port paste it bla bla type shit they would have NEVER guessed in months. but at least they got it working, right? well yeah duh. however they feel like something's missing... they don't know what, so they get LiveContainer from SideStore and her long lost twinulin LiveContainer2, then JIT, then help other people with SideStore even through injury, blood and weariness, and even make some friends on the way like IntelRyzen, WhosThatRetroGuy, pizzaman55, yotythepro, etc despite being very antisocial. Now you'd think the deep dark hole in their heart would be filled *now*, right? Nope. They remembered something. This name. So, they get the name of the anisette server and slap it on there, and even add what recently happnened. They're commiting this GitHub change to say, whoever knew, and whoever saw this monstrosity of an anisette server name, thank you for being there, even if all you saw was read fragments of it peiced together, lost to someone's poor memory. anyways my ball hair itchy hold on
